messages:
Priya (support): Hey team, escalation from ACME — they say users intermittently get OAuth callback errors for GitHub and Google. Error seen in-app: "callback state mismatch". Happens ~1-2% of attempts. Customer says it started after we added CloudFront in front of the auth callback.
customer-acme-ops: Confirmed. Users hit our /auth/callback?state=... then our backend logs show state != cookie. Sometimes state arrives with spaces instead of +. Example from a failing request: 
```
GET /auth/callback?state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.abc+def==&code=... HTTP/1.1
Host: app.acme.example
User-Agent: OAuthHandler/1.2
```
The cookie we issued had the state encoded as `eyJ...abc%2Bdef%3D%3D` (urlencoded plus and equals). In failing attempts request shows `abc def==` (space).
Priya (support): Thanks — did you notice if this is only on users behind certain ISPs/regions?
customer-acme-ops: Mostly EU users but a few NA. Not consistent by browser either.
Jon (eng-infra): CloudFront can normalize query strings if config or edge lambda rewrites run. Also certain proxies and WAFs sometimes treat `+` in query strings as space if the value isn't properly percent-encoded before a second decode pass. Could be double-decoding.
Maya (sre): Can we get raw request logs from CF/ALB? Need the exact bytes we received at the edge vs forwarded to origin. Also check if any edge worker is doing decodeURIComponent on the query.
customer-acme-ops: I pulled the ALB logs and here's a snippet (redacted):
```
https 1.2.3.4:443 10.0.0.5:443 0.002 0.001 200 302 "GET /auth/callback?state=eyJ...abc+def==&code=..." "Mozilla/5.0"
```
But when our backend prints the raw URL it shows `abc def==`.
Alex (devex): This looks like classic + vs %2B handling. In application/x-www-form-urlencoded context, `+` decodes to space. If something is treating the query param as form-encoded and doing a decode, that could convert `+` to space. CloudFront behaviors or some proxy header parsing libs do that.
Priya (support): Quick mitigation request from customer: can we accept both versions (space and +) for a short window?
Jon (eng-infra): Will need careful validation — state is security-sensitive (CSRF). But we can implement tolerant check: compare URL-decoded state with cookie value, and also compare after replacing spaces with `+`. Pseudocode: 
```
if (reqState === cookieState) return ok;
const alt = reqState.replace(/ /g, '+');
if (alt === cookieState) return ok;
```
This covers the +->space issue without permanently weakening checks. Add logging when tolerant match used.
Maya (sre): Deploy path: feature flag `oauth.tolerant_state_decoding` gated to 1% initially. Monitoring: count tolerant matches and downstream session creation rate. If spike -> rollback.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: service auth-handler v2.3.1 will include flag `oauth.tolerant_state_decoding`. Approval required from eng-infra.
Jon (eng-infra): Approve for canary. Also, we should fix origin: ensure CloudFront forward-query-string is enabled and disable any URL decode in edge lambdas. Check if ALB listener or any WAF rule rewrites query.
Alex (devex): Longer-term: encode state using base64url (no `+` or `/` or `=`) or use hex. Example safe encoding: `base64url(state)` -> `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _`. That avoids plus/space semantics. Suggest we add a migration: accept legacy states for N days.
customer-acme-ops: Can you share exact repro steps so we can validate on our side?
Priya (support): Repro steps we shared with you: 
1) Start OAuth flow in Chrome on a machine behind CloudFront-like proxy.
2) Before redirect to provider, set state cookie from our /auth/start endpoint and capture the exact header.
3) Complete OAuth provider flow (GitHub/Google) and observe callback URL. If callback state decodes to space -> you'll hit mismatch.
Also try curl to simulate: 
```
# Simulate provider redirect with + in state
curl -v "https://app.acme.example/auth/callback?state=eyJ...abc%2Bdef%3D%3D&code=TEST" \
  -H "Cookie: state=eyJ...abc%2Bdef%3D%3D"
# Variant where proxy decodes + -> space
curl -v "https://app.acme.example/auth/callback?state=eyJ...abc def==&code=TEST" \
  -H "Cookie: state=eyJ...abc%2Bdef%3D%3D"
```
Jon (eng-infra): For logging: include both raw query and req.getQueryString() in logs, plus raw socket bytes if possible. We should also log edge-id header from CF to correlate.
Maya (sre): I'll add an alert: if tolerant matches > 0.5% of auth attempts or if failure rate > 0.2% we roll back.
Alex (devex): Draft code snippet for base64url helper (Node): 
```
function base64UrlEncode(buf) {
  return Buffer.from(buf).toString('base64').replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');
}
function base64UrlDecode(s) {
  s = s.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
  while (s.length % 4) s += '=';
  return Buffer.from(s, 'base64');
}
```
Priya (support): Customer asked for ETA for canary fix. Jon, Maya — can we ship today to 1%?
Jon (eng-infra): Yes — canary patch plus logging now queued, will roll to 1% in ~45m.
Maya (sre): I'll watch metrics and confirm.
customer-acme-ops: Thanks. We'll run a small internal QA and report back. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Priya (support): I'll keep this thread updated with canary numbers. Thanks all. :eyes:
